headline: Three o'clock keeps its own counsel.
body: The stairwell light has been on since yesterday and no one has claimed it. A bus turns at the far corner, empty enough that the seats look arranged. We write this down because the hour will not keep itself.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: pre-dawn grey, no stars left to argue

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: one bus, wet curb, bins already out
